# Export label

The machine-readable ID is intentionally long. The indentation matters.

```text
manifest:
    workshop_exports:
        id: WORKSHOP_EXPORT_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789
        output: example/report.txt
```

A long inline value also wraps: `WORKSHOP_EXPORT_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789_ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ_0123456789`.

The last line should remain in the notes pane.
